name: Dr. Aaron Jeziorski
bio:
Dr. Aaron Jeziorski is a proud Arizona native who has built his career around one simple belief: every patient deserves a smile they love and a dentist they trust. He earned his Bachelor of Science in Kinesiology before going on to complete his Doctor of Dental Medicine degree at the Arizona School of Dentistry and Oral Health through A.T. Still University. Deeply committed to his craft, Dr. Jeziorski regularly attends seminars and conferences to stay at the forefront of dental innovation — because he believes the best care is always evolving.

Beyond the chair, Dr. Jeziorski gives back to the community he calls home by mentoring dental students at the Central Arizona Shelter Services Dental Clinic for the Homeless. It's that same spirit of genuine service that shapes every visit at Arizona Biltmore Dentistry — where patients aren't just treated, they're cared for. In fact, Dr. Jeziorski gives each patient his personal cell phone number, because real commitment to your care doesn't stop at the front door.

When he's not brightening smiles in Phoenix, Dr. Jeziorski is home with his soulmate Chrissy, whom he married in 2007, and their four children. Family is everything to him — and that warmth shows in the way he treats every patient who walks through his door.
